analyzed_vuln.description: Out-of-bounds read due to incorrect bounds check when mapping subset glyph IDs to hdmx width entries. operator[] computes width as &source_device_record->widthsZ[gid] and only checks `width < base + sizeDeviceRecord` (upper bound). It does not validate that `gid` is within the source record’s width array length, and the pointer arithmetic itself can produce a wild pointer before the check. This allows dereferencing invalid `*width` in DeviceRecord::serialize (crash seen in BEInt::operator uint8).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered during hdmx subsetting (hb_subset -> hdmx::subset -> hdmx::serialize -> DeviceRecord::serialize) with a malformed hdmx table where sizeDeviceRecord is small/truncated relative to glyph IDs selected in plan->glyphs. For a chosen gid >= available widths, SubsetView::operator[] forms an invalid pointer into widthsZ and returns it if the flawed pointer comparison passes, then serialize reads it via widthsZ[i].set(*width), causing a wild read/SEGV.
